_comment: Providers whose formal reviews MUST go through bin/ai-review-engine. pool/preflight refuse a review that bypasses the runner for any provider listed here. Door scripts own provider bits only (binary/profile, credentials, model pin, tool set, parse to our report shape). See docs/reviewer-harness-consolidation.md and plan_reviewer-pipeline-core.md §9 Phase D.

grok.notes: First proven door. Session CLI bin/ai-grok-review remains for persistent named sessions; formal pool reviews dispatch through the engine.

deepseek.notes: First OpenCode door on the same runner. Profile config/opencode-deepseek selects the model pin and tool set; formal pool reviews dispatch through the engine. Session CLIs bin/ai-deepseek and bin/ai-deepseek-agent remain for named sessions and debates.

muse.notes: Muse Code pinned CLI by default; AI_MUSE_ENGINE=opencode rolls onto the pinned OpenCode profile config/opencode-muse. Sessions never cross engines. Session CLI bin/ai-muse remains for persistent named sessions; formal pool reviews dispatch through the engine.

qwen.notes: Native Qwen Code CLI. Container sandbox preferred; a host without Docker/podman falls back to the reviewer-only tool set. Fingerprint requalification stays in bin/ai-review-preflight (Phase B versioned records). Session CLI bin/ai-qwen remains for persistent named sessions.

gemini.notes: Local agy runtime. Fingerprint requalification stays in bin/ai-review-preflight (Phase B versioned records) and is never owned by the door. Session CLI bin/ai-gemini remains for persistent named sessions.

stepfun.notes: StepCode under bubblewrap on Ubuntu/Linux; pinned OpenCode profile config/opencode-stepfun on Windows (folder + test shell, owner 2026-09-30). Platform rule: unsupported-platform when no engine fits, never quarantine. Session CLI bin/ai-stepfun remains for named sessions and debates.
